blocks.text: PROPHECY FULFILLING— There are famines, droughts and diseases in many parts of the world as predicted. This is the beginning of sorrows. Here is a late article of prophecy. AP- Beijing — A drought spreading across northern China has left at least 3.2 million people short of water, brought out swarms of locusts and threatened hundreds of thousands of farmers with economic ruin, state media reported (end quote). - The Chinese are building the worlds largest dam now because they know a world food shortage will come. Later this will cause them and Russia to cross over the Euphrates (Rev. 16:12). We already see the kings of the East preparing! Concerning the four elements, cataclysmic events will definitely involve all nations. Rev. 11:1-6 says the whole world is involved. After Russia and China join in a peace plan in the Mid-East with the USA they will break it with the anti-christ. They already have much of the secrets to our technology.

CELESTIAL PORTENTS - The heavens are already showing great powerful harbingers to come. Drastic and major changes in society, economics — almost every facet will be different. Some things in the heavens are taking place that have not been seen in hundreds or thousands of years — now and forward. Just look at the elections. The unexpected events are occurring, and all the other occurrences. (Ps. 19:1,2) — Also Jesus said in Luke 21:25 the warnings will come and explained it clearly. In the year June 2001, an eclipse will cross the bottom of Africa. They have not had one like this in 50 years! Somewhere before and in the future things will be effected in that part of the world. At a certain point, this one starting in the month of June 21, 2002, two heavenly bodies (Mars and Jupiter) will conjunct. They call this the ‘scepter’. — This may have to do with a leader and type of world calamity during the dates we mentioned. But the way it does it is a rare occurrence. This will effect clear into the year 2003. The earth will go through some amazing remarkable upheavals and perilous situations as science and technology continues, plus the super quakes and elements. — Too many things to mention here. But one more thing, the presidential cycles of assassination, if not broken up when Reagan survived the shooting, then one should watch for occurrences concerning the presidential office. We do know one thing, during this period some dramatic events effecting the USA and world will occur in a tremendous manner. Plus the pestilence and new viruses will continue to plague mankind. There is ever so much more in the heavens, but we will get to it in time. It is confirming God’s word perfectly (Job 28:30-33).

Footnote: Scientists by using three dimensional pictures of the heavens have said there is evidently parallel universes instead of just one. — Yes, there is no end to his kingdoms! The Almighty inhabits eternity!

THE LAST COURT OF APPEALS— Quite an interesting prophecy! — II Chron. 7:14, “If my people, which are called by my name, shall humble themselves, and pray, and seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways; then will | hear from heaven, and will forgive their sin, and will heal their land.” Right at the beginning as this nation started our forefathers sought His face in this manner.— Victory over England for our colonies! Our people have prayed this way through wars, including the Civil War, through World War | and II and He saved our nation! — Also economic crises, dust bowls, crop failure, tragedies, assassinations, disease and national shocks. We use this court of appeals with God and He heard. But the people would turn around and get more wicked each time. And now we're at the last court of appeals. Soon it will be over with because the Elect will be gone. And so shall it be saith the Lord.
—The prophetic clock is ticking it’s last prophecy to the churches!

| don’t think this is by accident, but could be the Spirit revealing a true point. The Spirit moved on me to put Psalms 91 here and could possibly catch part of the above that we have written and more so.

PSALMS: 91:1— “He that dwelleth in the secret place of the Most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.” (He that dwelleth is Jesus, the Word, faith and praise!) — Verse 2, “| will say of the Lord, He is my refuge and my fortresses: my God, in him will | trust.” (And he surely overshadowed this Temple!) — Verse 3, “Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, and from the noisome pestilence.” Even if Satan has trapped you He will set you free! And the noisome pestilence (this sounds like and is similar to Rev. 16:2), is any kind of energy weapon of radiation, etc. And below reveals He will shield you from any kind of sudden trouble — with His wings: Verse 4, “He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou trust; his truth shall be thy shield and buckler.” — As you trust, His word and promises will be with you. (This could be typical for some Tribulation saints too.) — Verse 5, “Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night, nor for the arrow that flieth by day.” David saw missiles. He looked into the future, the last days. — Verse 6, “Nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness; nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday.” David is describing not only energy but nuclear weapons of all sorts, and chemical warfare. — Verse 7, “A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand; but it shall not come nigh thee.” This explains how many are slain by terrible devices of destruction. And the terrorists could use this at any time besides Armageddon. — And yet He will stand with the Elect now and some others during the Tribulation (Rev.7).— Verse 8 and 9, “Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked. Because thou hast made the Lord, which is my refuge, even the most High, thy habitation.” When He comes back after the Translation you will behold what will happen to the wicked. Your trust in the Lord Jesus is the key! — Verse 10, There shall no evil befall thee, neither shall any plague come nigh thy dwelling.” Jesus has shown us that during our life he has kept diseases and pestilence away from us and if necessary in the future He will deliver! — Verse 11 and 12, “For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways. They shall bear thee up in their hands, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.” You have guardian angels and like never before they're going to guide you in the momentous days ahead! They will even guide you out of trouble that you never knew about. — Verse 13, “Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder; the young lion and the dragon shalt thou trample under feet.’ You'll be victorious over all of Satan’s powers. Right now in our age He will release stronger faith and anointing. —Verse 14, “Because He hath set his love upon me, therefore will | deliver him: | will set him on high, because he hath known my name.” God knows you personally and his divine love is in you. — “Now stir it up!” — Verse 15 and 16, “He shall call upon me, and | will answer him. With long life will | satisfy him, and shew him my salvation.” He will answer you and will give you long life with honour blending into eternal life! - This Psalms is futuristic and full of wisdom and knowledge!

Note: As predicted — giant winds — Prophetic update: A typhoon twice the size of Thailand struck Taiwan at this moment (Aug. 22, 2000) with 200 mph winds causing great destruction. — Plus greater ones will appear and super quakes and volcanic action. These signs show us the unity of the Elect is here!
